entities.label: Person
entities.summary: American architect (1867-1959) who designed over 1,000 structures including Fallingwater, the Guggenheim Museum, and Taliesin. His organic architecture philosophy — that buildings should harmonize with their environment — and Prairie Style innovations made him the most influential American architect of the 20th century.
